# `foxglove site-tokens`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](README.md)

```text
List and manage site tokens

Usage: foxglove site-tokens [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add     Create a token for a site controller and print it once
  delete  Delete a site token
  list    List site tokens
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
